title: Michael Bruce returns to Purplebricks as director
summary:
Michael Bruce has been officially reinstated as a director at Purplebricks' parent company Strike, according to Companies House records filed this week. The appointment marks a significant development for the fixed-fee property platform, which has undergone substantial restructuring since its acquisition by Strike in 2023.

title: MPs call for stamp duty overhaul to boost homeownership
summary:
The Housing, Communities and Local Government Committee has called for significant reforms to Stamp Duty Land Tax by the end of 2026. The cross-party group argues the current system creates barriers to homeownership and slows property market activity, with receipts down 6% year-on-year.

title: ‘Cuckooing’ crime affects 1,500 London properties
summary:
A BBC investigation has identified 1,539 incidents of 'cuckooing' reported to police in London between May 2025 and April 2026, where drug gangs have taken over residential properties from vulnerable occupants. The practice, now criminalised under the Crime and Policing Act 2026, involves criminals targeting elderly, disabled, or drug-dependent individuals and forcibly occupying their homes.

title: School group secures £1.75m bridge loan on West Kensington block
summary:
A private school group has secured £1.75 million in bridging finance against a block of buy-to-let flats in West Kensington to address liquidity pressures stemming from VAT changes in the education sector. Precise Mortgages completed the facility against an unencumbered block of five flats valued at £2.865 million.

title: OakNorth provides £11.7m for self-storage expansion
summary:
OakNorth has provided £11.7m in development finance to Cinch Self Storage to fund two purpose-built facilities in Bedford and Leeds. The developments will add more than 120,000 sq ft of lettable space to the operator's 27-location portfolio.

title: Dexters expands London network with Fraser & Co acquisition
summary:
London estate agency Dexters has acquired Fraser & Co, adding four London offices and a Hong Kong presence to its existing network. The deal brings more than 30 employees into the Dexters operation, which now runs more than 180 offices across the capital.

title: Air conditioning debate highlights UK housing regulation concerns
summary:
Environmental restrictions on air conditioning in new residential developments have sparked debate about regulatory burdens on UK housing delivery. A North London estate agent has highlighted planning system challenges affecting housing supply and affordability.

title: Liverpool estate agency launches AI property valuation tool
summary:
A Liverpool-based estate agency has launched a free AI-powered property valuation service that aims to address what its founders describe as widespread overpricing in the UK housing market. The tool analyses live sold prices, local demand data, crime statistics, flood risk information, and energy performance ratings.

title: Leeds letting agent dismissed after benefits discrimination claims
summary:
A Leeds-based letting agency has terminated an employee following the emergence of a recording in which the staff member appears to discuss filtering out prospective tenants who claim benefits. The practice is now explicitly prohibited under the Renters' Rights Act.

title: Ground rent cap implementation brought forward to 2027
summary:
The government will introduce a £250 annual cap on residential ground rents in England and Wales by late 2027, a year earlier than previously planned. The accelerated timeline affects more than four million leaseholders following pressure from MPs and parliamentary committees.
